\documentclass{article}\usepackage{tikz,enumitem}
\begin{document}
\begin{enumerate}[leftmargin=*, itemsep=3cm]
  \item Solve $2x + 3 = 11$.
  \item A ladder leans against a wall:
    \begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*), itemsep=3cm]
      \item Find the height it reaches.
      \item Find the angle it makes with the ground.
    \end{enumerate}
  \item Use the triangle to find $c$.
    \begin{tikzpicture}
      \draw (0,0) -- (4,0) -- (4,3) -- cycle;
      \node at (2,-0.4) {$a=6$};
      \node at (4.5,1.5) {$b=8$};
    \end{tikzpicture}
  \item Solve $x^2 = 49$.
\end{enumerate}
